title: Obama administration's UFO answers, then Obama's late-night statement

tellings.quote: I think as recently as like 2012, the Obama administration had was asked if they investigate UFOs and it was just kind of like left off.

plain: As late as about 2012, when the administration of President Barack Obama was asked whether the government investigates UFOs, the question was more or less left unanswered, according to the researcher who goes by RedPandaKoala. RedPandaKoala tells it without naming a source, setting it against a later moment when Obama himself spoke about UFOs on a late-night television show. The contrast is meant to show how quickly the official tone on the subject changed.
